prompt: A vibrant community garden in full bloom during spring morning, where rows of raised beds showcase different vegetables and flowers. In the foreground, bright red roses climb a wooden trellis while purple lavender bushes release their fragrance nearby. A weathered wooden bench sits along the gravel path, surrounded by terracotta planters overflowing with colorful marigolds and petunias. Near the tool shed, gardening gloves rest on a wheelbarrow filled with fresh soil, alongside a watering can and metal rake. However, this peaceful garden contains no thorny cacti or succulent plants, as the climate doesn't support such desert vegetation. You also won't spot any plastic flamingos or garden gnomes decorating the space, keeping the aesthetic natural and understated. Butterflies dance around the blooming sunflowers while bees work diligently among the white daisies. A sprinkler system waters the green grass pathways, and bird houses hang from sturdy oak trees overhead. Fresh herbs like basil and mint grow in dedicated sections, while a compost bin sits discretely in the corner next to stacks of clay pots.
